description: This file defines an object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' that provides utility functions for extracting and sanitizing action-related data, formatting messages, and generating JavaScript code for dispatching UI action status events in a Kotlin-based Android project.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts an action name from a JsonObject, looking for 'name' or 'action' fields.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a tag by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string with various sanitized parameters and optional context JSON.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript string to dispatch an event indicating the status of an action, with success or error.

methods.name: jsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON literal string, escaping Unicode line separator characters.
